title: Prune old log records
body:
Logs grow without limit. Add `cardinal logs prune --days N` to remove old records.

- R1: Deletes `$CARDINAL_HOME/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` files dated more than N days before today (UTC); files for today and the previous N days are kept.
- R2: Deletes rows in the `logs` table of `$CARDINAL_HOME/store.db` whose `at` is older than the same cutoff; newer rows are kept.
- R3: Prints `{"files_removed": <int>, "records_removed": <int>}` on stdout and exits 0. `--days` below 1 exits 2 with a JSON error on stderr and deletes nothing.

Add end-to-end tests that drive the CLI.
